title: feat: async export job queue
body: Moves export generation to a redis-backed worker pool. Part of export v2 work. Closes ENG-405.

title: feat: JSON export format
body: Adds JSON as a supported export format, reuses the v2 job queue. Closes ENG-408.

title: feat: export progress bar (frontend)
body: Websocket-driven progress bar for the export panel. Closes ENG-401.

title: chore: export v2 QA fixes
body: Small fixes found during the QA pass in ENG-410 (small/medium workspaces only).

title: docs: update export API docs for v2
body: Updates public API docs to reflect new async export endpoints.

title: fix: export v2 timeout on large workspaces
body: Adds cursor-based pagination to the export batch job so it stops loading the full workspace into memory at once. Should fix ENG-412 (export hangs/times out above ~50k rows). Tested locally against a synthetic 60k-row workspace, still need to verify against a dataset closer to northstar's real size (~80k rows) before merging. Holding on merge until QA signs off - don't want to re-announce this as fixed until it actually is.

title: export progress bar occasionally stuck at 99%
body: Cosmetic bug, job actually completes fine but the UI progress bar sticks at 99% for a few seconds before jumping to done.

title: fix: progress bar stuck at 99%
body: Fixes off-by-one in the progress event emitter. Closes #289.

title: rate limit export API per workspace
body: See ENG-415. A workspace kicking off 10+ concurrent exports can starve the worker pool for everyone else.

title: export audit log for SOC2
body: See ENG-395. Need to log actor, workspace, format, row count, timestamp for every export.

title: test: fix flaky export_v2_integration_test
body: Adds a small sleep + retry around the async job assertion. Underlying race was in the test fixture, not product code. See ENG-398.

title: better error messages on export failure
body: See ENG-407. 'export failed' with no reason is not actionable for support or customers.

title: chore: bump worker pool size for export jobs
body: Small mitigation while ENG-412 is in progress, gives more headroom for large exports. Not a real fix.

title: sales demo workspace is stale
body: See ENG-430. Demo data hasn't been refreshed since v1, doesn't showcase v2 features well.

title: fix: slow analytics dashboard queries
body: Adds a missing index that the tuesday migration should have included. See ENG-413.

title: evaluate export throughput at 200k rows
body: Follow-up benchmarking task once #288 lands. See ENG-433.
